verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a single pricing-page line listing "Data warehouse integration" as a feature of a higher tier. That confirms Heap ships the capability, but nothing describes how it works: no sync direction, cadence, supported warehouses, or schema. CSV exports and the track/bulk-track ingestion APIs are not continuous warehouse sync, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: documentation of continuous event export to a warehouse, supported destinations and sync frequency, any in-product querying of warehouse tables, developer setup docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
